sents.en: Butterflies are insects.
Beetles, dragonflies, and ants are all insects too.
All butterflies were once caterpillars.
A caterpillar forms a chrysalis.
It is like a shell.
A lot of changes happen inside.
Now it is an adult butterfly!
Butterflies live in many places.
You will often find them near flowers and plants.
sents.ko: 꽃과 식물 가까이에서 자주 볼 수 있어요.

sents.en: Butterflies come in all sizes and colors.
Some butterflies have beautiful patterns on their wings.
sents.ko: 어떤 나비는 날개에 아름다운 무늬가 있어요.

sents.en: Butterflies have three main body parts.
They are the head, thorax, and the abdomen.
Butterflies have two large eyes and two antennae.
sents.ko: 나비는 큰 눈 두 개와 더듬이 두 개가 있어요.

sents.en: They have six legs and four wings.
sents.ko: 다리는 여섯 개, 날개는 네 개예요.

sents.en: Butterflies drink nectar and plant juices.
sents.ko: 나비는 꽃의 꿀과 식물의 즙을 마셔요.

sents.en: A butterfly moves pollen from flower to flower.
This helps plants to grow.
sents.ko: 그래서 식물이 자라는 데 도움이 돼요.

sents.en: Wow! Butterflies have an interesting life cycle.
They change from a caterpillar to a beautiful butterfly.
I hope you see a butterfly today.
They are so pretty. Bye!
